from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
module = importlib.import_module('tenacity')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'tenacity/__init__.py').resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt
def original(value=7, *, label="saved"):
 return value,label
wrapped=retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(1))(original)
print("wrapper_defaults",wrapped.__defaults__,wrapped.__kwdefaults__)
assert wrapped.__defaults__==original.__defaults__
assert wrapped.__kwdefaults__==original.__kwdefaults__
assert wrapped.__wrapped__ is original
assert wrapped()==(7,"saved")
assert wrapped(2,label="new")== (2,"new")
